previous_goal_turn: progress: four frozen ordinary red logs proved a new candidate counterexample, preserved gradients and 866 formal sources, and changed the adoption decision
root_causes: Adding a large shared maximum before subtracting the target loses normalization information.
Adding tiny exponentials to 1 before Log loses representable tail information.
Computing individual tail exponentials before summing can underflow a representable aggregate.
Rounding each group or position before averaging or summing can lose a representable aggregate.

slots.normalization: Track the first maximum index and the maximum of the remaining entries during the finite-value scan. Keep the original gradient sum loop unchanged. Separately sum exp(value-tailMaximum) excluding the first maximum, and form logTail=(tailMaximum-maximum)+Log(tailSum).
slots.ordinary_tail: For logTail >= -512*Ln2, add Log1p(Exp(logTail)) to reported loss only. Preserve shifted target gaps and existing gradient calculations.
slots.tiny_tail: For logTail < -512*Ln2, accumulate Exp(logTail+512*Ln2) without rounding to the subnormal range. At this magnitude log(1+x) differs from x by a relative error below 2^-512, far below float64 precision. Convert the aggregate once with Ldexp after all groups/positions.
slots.media_mean: Add maximum/2-target/2 per group. Accumulate ordinary log-normalizers before dividing their sum by 2. Convert tiny aggregate with Ldexp(tinySum,-513), then add to the mean. Reject a genuinely non-finite mean with zero,nil,error.
slots.textgen_sum: Keep existing per-position finite gap/loss and running-sum guards, masks and count. Add the tiny aggregate with Ldexp(tinySum,-512) after all scored positions. No averaging or count-contract change.

expected_results: All frozen v2 uniform/common-offset/finite-mean/nonfinite regressions remain passing.
Media winner positions 0,1,2 each match Log1p(2*Exp(-40)). Textgen winner 0,27,258 each match Log1p(258*Exp(-40)).
Media equal groups [0,-745,-1000] and [0,-745.5,-745.5] each return Float64bits 1; [0,-746,-746] and a single contributing group correctly round to 0.
Textgen 258 tails at gap746 returns bits54. Two scored rows with 258 tails each at gap751 return summed NLL bits1.
Every recorded gradient bit hash stays equal to the original within the same build and input.

Twelve normal media updates and fresh-process continuation of the four already preserved original checkpoints keep complete state/optimizer/update bytes; reported normal loss is finite, nonnegative and within the existing 16-ULP control contract.
